title: Impact of mobile connectivity on students' wellbeing: Detecting learners' depression using machine learning algorithms
summary: A cross-sectional survey of 444 students uses eight ML classifiers to distinguish depression severity in relation to mobile/internet connectivity. The paper reports associations within this single-university sample; this supports a limited behavioral/mental-health result, not a causal effect of connectivity or clinical diagnosis.
